meta.title: How to Season a Wok (non-stick the first time you use it!) | Kenji's Cooking Show
meta.description:
Donate to No Kid Hungry here: https://p2p.onecause.com/livestreamfornokidhungry/kenji-alt-lopez

Get my books (including The Food Lab and my new book, The Wok) here: https://www.kenjilopezalt.com

first part of it is that you're heating up the metal um and the iron there is going to react with oxygen and form what's called black oxide um and that's the initial process where you can see this one kind of has a bluish tinge to it it's going to turn black as it starts to heat up and that's the reaction between the metal and the oxygen forming black oxide that's the first part of seasoning now layers of polymers on there and that's what's going to give a western style skillet it's really smooth glossy non-stick finish now that's possible in a western skillet because generally in a western
